set.body: Non-gating follow-ups from the Atlas repair review (post-01M14YYA4486CF8Z18417BQN7X). Paths: view/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/view/atlas.scala, view/src/test/scala/storymodel4s/view/AtlasSuite.scala. Items: (a) Extent.unsafe (atlas.scala ~174-176) throws and is on the production path (~319) — replace with a checked constructor + traverse or a private[view] trusted path that cannot throw; (b) private constructors + of/apply for ProjectionContract, Anchor (non-negativity), VisualIdentity, AtlasSpec, AtlasCompiler (mirror CodexCompiler private); (c) markId(address, kind: String) → salt from a small enum / the VisualPrimitive case; (d) Scaladoc on AtlasCompiler.compile/apply, SceneNavigation.from, Extent.of, NarrativeLevel.showsSituations, AtlasTextualTwin.render, EvidenceVisibility.visibleClaims; (e) Map.apply at ~312 (situationSupport) and ~439 (discoursePosition) → Option or a pre-built Map[SituationId, Anchor] over visibleSituations. Gate: view + fixtures WOG suites green on JVM/JS/Native; no public-vocabulary change beyond constructor privacy. Start only after the combined visualization commit is acked.
